messages:
monica: Ran the eval CI for model-recon-v2 with quantization profile q4_0. Runner exported compare CSV with counts off, diff view shows 0 samples for some buckets :thinking:
raj: saw same. export size 512 -> mismatch between reported total_samples and actually exported rows. Logs show "mapper: unmapped_sample_ids=12"
sylvia: can you paste the runner args and the export command?
monica: command pasted:
```
./runner --job eval --model model-recon-v2 --quant q4_0 --export /tmp/out.csv --seed 0
```
monica: tail of log:
```
INFO sample_mapper: mapped 500/512
WARN sample_mapper: 12 ids missing, fallback to padding
ERROR exporter: wrote 500 rows, expected 512
```
raj: interestingly, when I re-ran with `--seed 42` it produced 512 rows. so nondet? :eyes:
sylvia: could be a sample-mapper hashing bug when prompt keys are empty or None, sampler edge-case.
monica: also the diffpanel aggregates by metric group; missing rows cause the aggregator to clamp counts and normalization yields NaN in the scorecard UI. noticed on the compare view.
jordan: @monica can you attach the problematic CSV + run metadata? i'll try to reproduce locally.
ci-bot: CI: rerun started for job eval/2003456789 by monica
raj: small repro: seed=0 + shuffle=True + custom sampler produced off-by-one when dataset length % batch_size != 0 — last batch trimmed instead of padded.
sylvia: quick mitigation: exporter should write padding rows with a sentinel_id and mark them as "padded" so downstream agg can ignore them. also add a validation step that compares exported_rows to metadata.total_expected and fail-fast.
monica: filing a PR to runner: add pad-sentinel + validation + strict count-check that triggers SLO alert. assigning @jordan to review.
jordan: will take it, adding unit test for sampler edge-case and an integration test that validates export row counts vs expected. draft PR by EOD.
monica: thanks :thumbsup: let's also add a dashboard alert rule that fires if export_row_count < expected by >1% to catch this earlier.
raj: ack — i'll add the alert rule in observability repo and wire it to the eval-run tag.
sylvia: note for postmortem: tie regression alerts to eval-run id + model version to reduce noise and speed triage.
monica: creating a short runbook in ops-docs and will ping once PR is merged.
ci-bot: CI: rerun finished — success.
